card.title: PS5 APU liquid metal inspection and spill check

claims.statement: The thermal interface material is paired to the APU.
claims.evidence: Annotation pointing to the APU frame.

claims.statement: Inspect for hot spots on the APU surface.
claims.evidence: Annotation pointing to the liquid metal surface.

claims.statement: Inspect the mainboard for liquid metal spills.
claims.evidence: Annotation pointing to the surrounding mainboard area.

cautions: Liquid metal is conductive and can cause shorts if spilled on the mainboard.
card.caveats: Does not provide specific temperature thresholds or cleaning procedures.
